name: FileStreamBot
description: A Telegram Bot to Convert Telegram Files To Direct & Streamable Links.

FLOG_CHANNEL.description: Channel ID where uploaded files get logged/stored

ULOG_CHANNEL.description: Channel ID where new-user notifications go

FQDN.description: Public hostname of your deployment, e.g. my-bot.onrender.com

HAS_SSL.description: true if your public URL is https

NO_PORT.description: true to omit the port from generated links (Render/Koyeb)

AUTO_PING.description: true/false. Force keep-alive pinger on/off; unset = auto-detect

CHUNK_SIZE.description: Bytes fetched per Telegram request while streaming. Default 1048576

MAX_STREAMS_PER_IP.description: Max concurrent /dl downloads per IP. Default 8

RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS.description: Max /dl or /watch requests per IP per window. Default 60

RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW.description: Window in seconds for RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS. Default 60

MAX_CONCURRENT_TRANSMISSIONS.description: Parallel MTProto connections per client. Default 6

MULTI_TOKEN1.description: Optional extra bot token/session string for load-balanced streaming

FORCE_UPDATES_CHANNEL.description: true to require users join FORCE_SUB_ID before use

FORCE_SUB_ID.description: Channel ID users must join if FORCE_UPDATES_CHANNEL is true

AUTH_USERS.description: Space-separated user IDs allowed to use the bot (blank = everyone)
